items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S5525

SPONSOR: THOMAS
 
TITLE OF BILL:  An act to amend the social services law, in relation
to enacting the intergenerational poverty mitigation act

 
PURPOSE GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

The purpose of this bill shall be to collaborate in mitigating genera-
tional poverty in the state of New York, to the best of the state's
ability.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

3) Section 484-a shall define the terms "cycle of poverty," "intergener-
ational poverty," and "poverty."

2) Section 484-b shall establish the New York intergenerational welfare
reform commission.

3) Section 484-c shall establish the intergenerational poverty plan
implementation pilot program.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Generational poverty is a conundrum that effects many racial groups
nationwide, especially African-Americans. It has served as a roadblock
in so many people's lives, obstructing them in their efforts towards
advancement. This contributes to high levels of poverty among those
effected.

Therefore, we should establish a commission and an implementation pilot
program, to lessen the grip generational poverty has on millions of
people's lives, and to prevent others from having to experience social
and economic stagnation.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New legislation.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS FOR STATE AND LOCAL GOVERNMENTS:

None to the state.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Relates to the intergenerational poverty mitigation act; creates a commission to study intergenerational poverty and a pilot program to address intergenerational poverty subject to appropriation.
